technical.title: MBZUAI releases PAN 2, a 29B world model for physical AI.
technical.summary: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models released PAN 2 under an Apache 2.0 license, combining an LLM planner with a 29B diffusion transformer to simulate action outcomes as video for up to 20 seconds.
technical.why: World models of this scale are crucial for research and development in physical AI and robotics.

technical.title: FAME-QP introduces GPU-accelerated quadratic programming for real-time model predictive control.
technical.summary: FAME-QP is a GPU-accelerated solver for dense quadratic programs in linear model predictive control, utilizing constraint-dependent operators and fused CUDA graph iterations to lower latency while maintaining accuracy in robotic simulations.
technical.why: Faster quadratic programming solvers directly improve the real-time control performance of autonomous systems and humanoids.

technical.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 enhances robot dexterity, reliability, and safety.
technical.summary: Google's capable vision-language-action model has been updated to Gemini Robotics 2.5, significantly improving real-world general robot dexterity, safety, and operational reliability.
technical.why: Directly impacts computer vision and autonomous robotics engineering by advancing vision-language-action integration.

technical.title: Evolving Infra optimizes LLM serving and KV cache for agent workloads.
technical.summary: Evolving Infra is a new serving framework that dynamically adapts compute allocation and KV cache management to agent workloads, overcoming the load imbalances and cache evictions common in standard prefill-decode disaggregated systems.
technical.why: It directly addresses infrastructure bottlenecks faced when deploying high-demand agentic AI workloads at scale.

technical.title: SteerDistill improves low-bit quantization for LLM agents using teacher feedback.
technical.summary: SteerDistill is a quantization-aware distillation method where a full-precision teacher model guides student agents to correct behavioral divergences and failed rollouts, preventing task success degradation caused by low-bit quantization.
technical.why: This technique helps maintain agent performance while reducing the inference cost of low-bit models.

technical.title: AlphaProof Code agents verify complex software with millions of Lean proofs.
technical.summary: AlphaProof Code agents successfully wrote three million lines of formal proofs in Lean to verify Signal's core encryption protocol.
technical.why: Showcases a major milestone in deep automated software verification using AI agents.

technical.title: Java developers can build production-ready autonomous agents with Amazon Bedrock.
technical.summary: A technical guide demonstrates how Java developers can build autonomous AI agents using Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI, covering tool calling, conversation memory, resilience, multi-agent orchestration, and deployment via AgentCore.
technical.why: Provides practical patterns for deploying enterprise-grade autonomous agents using AWS infrastructure.

technical.title: Google announces Gemini Decisions API for fast multimodal decision-making.
technical.summary: The Gemini Decisions API has been introduced, driven by the Gemini Decision model to deliver fast and calibrated multimodal decisions.
technical.why: Expands multimodal capabilities for applications requiring rapid automated decision-making.

technical.title: Trovata builds autonomous treasury agents on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore.
technical.summary: Trovata engineered autonomous treasury agents using Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, featuring an RBAC-secured architecture that enables real-time, AI-driven corporate financial decision-making.
technical.why: Demonstrates secure, enterprise-scale implementation of agentic workflows in fintech.

technical.title: TCS builds agentic test orchestrator using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
technical.summary: Tata Consultancy Services developed an agentic test orchestrator on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that converts requirements into governed tests for BFSI clients, cutting internal testing effort by 88%.
technical.why: Highlights productivity gains achieved through specialized, governed multi-agent architectures.

business.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO following board investigation
business.summary: Nvidia cofounder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after the company opened an investigation into his affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset.
business.why: Executive leadership changes at key hardware suppliers can significantly impact market strategy and stability.

business.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid scandals
business.summary: Nvidia's board separated from Jensen Huang after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy and another with an executive.
business.why: Top-level leadership shakeups at Nvidia carry immense ramifications for the broader AI industry.

business.title: UFORCE hits $6 billion valuation amid battle-tested drone demand
business.summary: Ukrainian defense tech startup UFORCE reached a $6 billion valuation as investors bet on its battle-tested NEMESIS drones and MAGURA naval vessels.
business.why: It highlights massive market growth and valuation spikes in autonomous combat systems.

business.title: Data center boom faces serious real-world obstacles and cancellation risks
business.summary: The data center boom is encountering local opposition, permitting delays, electricity shortages, and the risk that many announced projects may never be built.
business.why: Infrastructure bottlenecks directly threaten the physical scaling of future AI compute clusters.

business.title: Nebius shares fall 10% on increased 2026 capex spend outlook
business.summary: Nebius shares dropped 10% after the company issued a weak outlook and expected increased capital expenditure spend for 2026.
business.why: It reflects changing market sentiments regarding infrastructure spending timelines for neocloud providers.

business.title: Backlash and red tape continue to slow data center expansion
business.summary: Real-world obstacles like local opposition, permitting delays, and electricity scarcity are slowing down the ongoing data center boom.
business.why: It impacts how rapidly autonomous driving and vision compute facilities can be deployed.

business.title: Nvidia partner Megaspeed faces U.S. probe over chip exports
business.summary: Megaspeed is central to a U.S. probe regarding its role in sending billions of restricted Nvidia chips to China.
business.why: Regulatory investigations into hardware supply chains can disrupt global chip distribution.
